brand.font_stack: Bebas Neue, Impact, Arial Black, sans-serif

frames.feel: sparse intro, snare roll at 4.7s, SURGE at 10s-12s, warm low-mid energy builds
frames.visual: Title slams in at 1.579s on phrase start. Cyan accent flickers on snare roll (4.7-5.6s). Type scales 120% on SURGE at 10s, then glitches on DROP at 11s. Background pulses warm gradient on bass onsets.

frames.feel: heavy bass drops, dense onsets, SURGE at 26s and 36s, sustained kick rolls 32-35s
frames.visual: Each phrase edge (15.6s, 22.5s, 29.5s) triggers hard cut. 'BREAKBEAT' strobes cyan on kick. 'STORM' red flash on SURGE 26s. Accel-roll 32-35s creates strobing border vignette. Final frame scales type 150% at 36s SURGE.

frames.feel: heavy bass/sub dominance, multiple hard DROPs (51s, 53s, 56s), sustained hihat fill 38-40s, highest energy at 52s
frames.visual: Split-screen glitch on DROP 51s: left half inverts colors. DROP 53s freezes frame for 0.2s. Hihat fill 38-40s adds cyan scan-lines. SURGE 52s explodes type into particles, reassembles at 53s. DROP 56s hard cut to solid accent bg.

frames.feel: sparse return, warm low-mid, slower onset density, snare rolls 60s and 68s, rebuilds energy toward 71s
frames.visual: Slow crossfade in. Type animates letter-by-letter over 2 bars. Warm orange gradient bleeds from corners on bass hits. Snare roll 68s triggers subtle RGB offset. No hard cuts—smooth camera push-in toward phrase end at 71s.

frames.feel: final high energy push, DROP at 74s, cuts to void at 76s
frames.visual: Artist tag slams top-right at 71.03s. Type scales on each downbeat. DROP 74s freezes frame white-flash. At 76s hard cut to black, artist tag fades cyan glow for 4 seconds of silence.
